analyst.summary: Nestle India just posted its best back-to-back quarters in years - double-digit volume growth and 26-46% profit growth over the last two prints - but a meaningful part of that is a GST rate-cut base effect that will fade through FY27, and a third of the business (milk and nutrition products) is now flat-to-shrinking, with confectionery and coffee doing the heavy lifting instead. The company remains debt-free and highly profitable, and results due July 22 are expected to stay strong, but at roughly 77-78 times earnings - well above FMCG peers - the stock already prices in growth the business has not sustained over a full three-year cycle. We rate this a Hold: a quality franchise, fully priced, with no margin of safety.
